name: v0.3.16 early parent re-entry and local frontier lease
one_shot_semantics: After this protocol commit and the later candidate-freeze commit, run the 12 preregistered new candidate cells once. Rerun only an exact cell that fails for infrastructure reasons. Do not change early re-entry, cluster matching, frontier definition, lease slot count, ordering, budgets, or gates after the first target result.
research_question: Can two parameter-free lifecycle invariants repair the v0.3.15 same-parent false handoff and the buggy-lab local-frontier starvation without an app-specific rule and without a new horizon threshold?
not: permission to rewrite v0.3.14 or v0.3.15 evidence
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the first target result

failure_analysis.l1_l9_causality: downstream trajectory only; first divergence does not establish direct cause

invariant_a_early_parent_reentry.rule: After an action on an active non-returning sequence, a destination that matches the recorded parent exact signature or parent cluster completes that sequence once, even if commitment_left has not reached zero.
invariant_a_early_parent_reentry.already_returning: historical return path only; no early event
invariant_a_early_parent_reentry.finding_or_crash_same_step: Inspected historical behavior already emits the finding or crash terminal and, when the destination matches the parent, completes the physical lifecycle without a second returned terminal. The candidate keeps that behavior and does not emit early_parent_reentry for a sequence historical logic already completed.

source_parent_fallback.when: Before nested continuation or handoff classification, an active non-returning sequence whose current source already matches its recorded parent exact signature or cluster is closed once. The current action is then processed as a fresh branch through normal history.

invariant_b_local_frontier_lease.definition: For the child-parent hub cluster, branch keys that are discovered and not started and not completed and have no structural attempt. Cluster-aware union across recorded hub variants. The just-resolved child branch is excluded. Return actions are not branch keys.
invariant_b_local_frontier_lease.observation: Visible branch clicks on a hub state GhostQA has already reached are recorded into the existing BranchLedger discovered set. No manifest read, no hidden-topology scan, no URL or bug id.
invariant_b_local_frontier_lease.empty_frontier: Behave exactly like v0.3.14: restore outer, commitment 0, returning true, emit deferred sequence_horizon_reached, return toward the outer parent.
invariant_b_local_frontier_lease.nonempty_frontier: Restore the same outer identity and original parent, grant exactly one structural slot (commitment_left 1, returning false), emit local_frontier_lease_granted, and do not emit deferred sequence_horizon_reached yet.
invariant_b_local_frontier_lease.monotonicity: A successful lease start strictly decreases the remaining known frontier unless a newly observed state variant reveals a new branch key, recorded as frontier_new_keys_from_variant.
